name: NPC Spawner
displayDescription:
Spawn any character as an AI bot in private servers!

Type in chat:
• !spawn [name] [amount]: spawn bots in front of you (example: !spawn carrier, !spawn g4 2, !spawn titan cameraguy)
• !clearbots: remove your bots
• !find [name]: check which character a short name picks

Short names work: tcg = Titan Cameraguy, g2 = G Man 2.0, wod = Watchguy Of Doom, and more.

Up to 5 of your bots at a time. Works in every mode, in private servers only.

Already own every character at Lv. 100? You unlock this for free!
